# SEG-032-T008 (contract section 14): identifiers that must never appear in the Genesis Z80/audio/materialization production tree.
# One case-insensitive regular expression per line; '#' starts a comment. Reading this list never names a commercial byte, address or hash.
# titles and game identifiers
sonic
hedgehog
golden[ _-]?axe
streets[ _-]?of[ _-]?rage
\bout[ _-]?run\b
cool[ _-]?spot
\bgame[ _-]?id\b
\btitle[ _-]?id\b
# the known Sega-era compression / driver families (a decompressor name would be per-title knowledge)
saxman
kosinski
nemesis
enigma
comper
smps
# per-game images, driver lists, sample ranges, manual dumps, recorded coverage used as discovery authority
image[ _-]?list
driver[ _-]?list
driver[ _-]?manifest
image[ _-]?manifest
z80[ _-]?manifest
per[ _-]?game
pcm[ _-]?range
sample[ _-]?(range|table)s?\b
z80[ _-]?ram[ _-]?dump
coverage[ _-]?(seed|hint|manifest)
# a hash literal (a ROM hash selecting behaviour, or a content hash baked into the source)
(?<![0-9a-f])[0-9a-f]{64}(?![0-9a-f])
